forbidden.name: agent-loop-isolation
forbidden.comment: No src/ outside packages/core/agent-loop may import the concrete loop; bundles compose it via cordis.yml. Tests mount it for real-composition evidence and are out of scope.

forbidden.name: no-deep-src-imports
forbidden.comment: Cross-package product imports use public entry points, never a package src/ tree. Experimental and test-support packages are internal and out of scope.

forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: No import cycle between workspace packages.

forbidden.name: vendor-isolation
forbidden.comment: The vendored framework layer never depends on the harness.
